meta.name: ecommerce-full-pipeline
meta.description: 电商运营在开展跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏业务时，若需解决选品难、上架繁琐等痛点，必用此技能！一键打通“爆品挖掘→1688采集→多平台上架→推广文案→短视频生成”全自动流水线，轻松实现端到端自动化，让开店运营效率翻倍。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动完成从爆品挖掘到上架推广的电商全流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做跨境电商或闲鱼捡漏，想省掉选品上架的繁琐
copy.tagline_en: Automate the full ecommerce flow from product discovery to listing and promotion
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do cross-border or Xianyu sales and want to skip manual listing.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会按你的需求调用这套命令行工具：从 1688 采集商品并清洗数据、生成微信小店/Shopify/TikTok 上架模板与推广文案，也能做爆品趋势挖掘、闲鱼捡漏评分和推广短视频。
howto.when: 当你要开展跨境电商业务（如选品、上架、推广等），或想做闲鱼二手选品捡漏时触发接管。

say.text: 帮我从 1688 采集蓝牙耳机，清洗后生成多平台上架模板
say.note: 对应 scrape → clean → publish 流程

say.text: 用投影仪关键词在闲鱼找 999 元以内、支持 4K 的捡漏
自动挖爆品并生成 15 秒竖屏推广短视频
say.note: 对应 trend / video 命令

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can run this CLI toolkit: scrape 1688 products, clean data, generate listing templates for Shopify/TikTok, write promo copy, mine trending items, score Xianyu bargains and render vertical promo videos.
howto.when_en: When you need cross-border e-commerce work such as product picking, listing or promotion, or Xianyu second-hand bargain hunting.

say_en.text: Scrape Bluetooth earphones from 1688, clean data, build listing templates
Hunt Xianyu for projectors under 999 yuan with 4K support
Mine trending products and make a 15-second vertical promo video
